lessons.text: Never use appeal to ignorance (Treating the absence of disproof as proof (or the reverse)). It cost you against Linus Torvalds.
Never use slippery slope (Claiming one step inevitably cascades to catastrophe without support). It cost you against Linus Torvalds.
